Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 60, "heading": "V BÂTONS DANS LES ROUES", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u060-r0030", "target": "Он спрыгнул с тильбюри.", "source_sha256": "440cbc5aa026b896a0c648198f2dd3d206a9bd504e66520e1f2522dd5ffcc5bd", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u060-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "830070b21f625ca958d01c744bd9e37851c40b22acee1690d3dda66bfc22ef27"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u060-r0031", "target": "— Что вы такое говорите, друг мой?", "source_sha256": "ec277f0836bb15f2158d3b85ee6176e3d7881c13fd227e1216436de5f2510494", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u060-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "0c6f4052da006ce79b2e7926abe517c1c99f3d255a37074640ad40d9288d57db"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 1, "book": 7, "chapter": 5, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u060-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je dis que c’est un miracle que vous ayez fait cinq lieues sans rouler, vous et votre cheval, dans quelque fossé de la grande route. Regardez plutôt.", "sha256": "35809adc3850387655b3ab7648714d1b99adf94235f7099f2fd0c6a300a32f63", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "La roue en effet était gravement endommagée. Le choc de la malle-poste avait fendu deux rayons et labouré le moyeu dont l’écrou ne tenait plus.", "sha256": "7bf722a19307d7f6d18cfacb483041bba5892ec2bfc0b56bec35f7dcc247f952", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mon ami, dit-il au garçon d’écurie, il y a un charron ici ?", "sha256": "e3b180b1d1632134f2f2f8f37b3aabc4bb7b2055c31e8addfe9873587cfbe34a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sans doute, monsieur.", "sha256": "eb51feef8b60bafe28c1e22548273eeaa25e0b7d15a976cc7c915c2dc23458a6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Rendez-moi le service de l’aller chercher.", "sha256": "b6bfcf3cc5ca09f2e393d9c98e641f9969272941d60ef0b2c837d94a86a52d82", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il est là, à deux pas. Hé ! maître Bourgaillard !", "sha256": "a33844ea20be241734839c0981d64cc351671cb4137837ab35cbbbec8afd7681", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "Maître Bourgaillard, le charron, était sur le seuil de sa porte. Il vint examiner la roue et fit la grimace d’un chirurgien qui considère une jambe cassée.", "sha256": "0ff171379a2ce507bd0e347dfca8c521233e3b43c74e69dfe5545a760cfb1e42", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pouvez-vous raccommoder cette roue sur-le-champ ?", "sha256": "8465cf2f5f66135e8271a6982ee5d282cd92b18a02974b4edc822f7f7cf1b53b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, monsieur.", "sha256": "0d5465ec58ffd8a169046d0b5a9216b597e575402307c2d51b58ce3a1f4a288b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quand pourrai-je repartir ?", "sha256": "4bef8af6b20acbce23eef0ffbe119d2059d1a68c9e57fd0e722daf486aae0023", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Demain.", "sha256": "9c3348dd843c29a10de640ec1e0fa818c2ffada08210f2f070cae504fa766a1b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Demain !", "sha256": "b2285b6d14d1c2f005f3a39d4730f28910ed5c07c4282344c2a94d6271b2b841", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il y a une grande journée d’ouvrage. Est-ce que monsieur est pressé ?", "sha256": "b5bf9b9c333f5e5ebc35e9f4a97c090c4536f6a23938de1b10310eb67face82d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Très pressé. Il faut que je reparte dans une heure au plus tard.", "sha256": "5b75b0d1b7874a75048cedf96b2fed080f76b67f89f614982b22a9774befd272", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Impossible, monsieur.", "sha256": "d57bccc843200f93da85607ddcb2e4b6bfbdcac803b5977038cbd7469b2adbf6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je payerai tout ce qu’on voudra.", "sha256": "19cfe7dce6be71d79d788e815a4fb4accd56318245711ea3b67385b4aaeab77b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Impossible.", "sha256": "727dc0506b7fbe6a845b447d96d22621b6edf93037b9ec2e173c6d7634480922", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien ! dans deux heures.", "sha256": "f6c14a2695371d55086ee5a0096e3de14903fd635a7295ec133c4ee4a1637784", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Impossible pour aujourd’hui. Il faut refaire deux rais et un moyeu. Monsieur ne pourra repartir avant demain.", "sha256": "cac09e63f602527b8d12f6fdd61f9475270b22188569c34a793b4381d666dcea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— L’affaire que j’ai ne peut attendre à demain. Si, au lieu de raccommoder cette roue, on la remplaçait ?", "sha256": "f2ddfd549e5ca56d5e5204fff6c921d11fac23a6d1941b3a7c19281320090ba2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comment cela ?", "sha256": "d3362c5ad884845b6ac71bb569ddf77261553ee7e5ad465bcf67d3a116f4c11f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous êtes charron ?", "sha256": "4ba10c5239da1fdbf177769950da21d9e5a08e0fa266f116b07fc32a3f981d2e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sans doute, monsieur.", "sha256": "eb51feef8b60bafe28c1e22548273eeaa25e0b7d15a976cc7c915c2dc23458a6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Est-ce que vous n’auriez pas une roue à me vendre ? Je pourrais repartir tout de suite.", "sha256": "184fe73c3d6dac6adbb38f2106659274e3cb61b0d73662619f0eecc259bc18ec", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Une roue de rechange ?", "sha256": "9fdc99243ce23754ff7f6a8901d9ab2021d19ccd44d7c0186f97d35bde8e1efe", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je n’ai pas une roue toute faite pour votre cabriolet. Deux roues font la paire. Deux roues ne vont pas ensemble au hasard.", "sha256": "d3f3839b47acadae7c3124d8705801db1411ed7678994643beae8cfd0a3db3b1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— En ce cas, vendez-moi une paire de roues.", "sha256": "02c26e160268d217ba51aa266d2d57d1b3bd004c57d89346d401e4129653139d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Monsieur, toutes les roues ne vont pas à tous les essieux.", "sha256": "43904497b3d842f4e0b30c677ba63772b4b027f317913508ed05a8acdd3a4ce7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Essayez toujours.", "sha256": "77bb9a94105ddd7e2585e65af3db3ffb0f99ee9bff7dff60193179b3e6406fd0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est inutile, monsieur. Je n’ai à vendre que des roues de charrette. Nous sommes un petit pays ici.", "sha256": "eafb1e9475fd64966a0a2fe8cc62a794e8db2dc2d8b24b6e08825577dfa7d6ee", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Auriez-vous un cabriolet à me louer ?", "sha256": "3d0afc2dbe1964ec5b877de247e94d6764fe360beb590ca571eeb5e8ff3e105e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
